parsedVerdict.reasoning: OrderService acts as an application service. It coordinates domain operations (reserve, release, dispatch, nextState, assertCancellable, toStockLevel) and persists through injected ports (OrderRepository, ProductRepository). It contains no transport, framework or concrete persistence logic. The logic it owns itself is checking input, merging duplicate lines and undoing reservations so an order is all-or-nothing, which is unit-of-work coordination and fits the application layer. Core business rules (state transitions, whether an order can be cancelled, stock reservation) are delegated to the domain. Two borderline points don't amount to a clear violation: the order's status is set directly ("placed", "cancelled") rather than through domain methods, and randomUUID and new Date() are used directly instead of injected ports.
